posts.author: Glaiveworks
posts.body:
YOUR PROJECT TITLE
​
Heaven's Glaive​
SECTION A: SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
Lead the members of Squad 56 across the Island of Principium as they uncover the secrets of their forebearers.
Explore a vast island filled with fantastical foes, ruins, quests, and experience the story you choose. Each Protagonist brings a different viewpoint and story in this turn based RPG.
IMAGES/SCREENSHOTS
Spoiler
SECTION B: CHARACTERS
Spoiler
A.L.
: An Automaton rebuilt by Tenshi as a child. Without any memory or hint of what his original purpose was, he found a new purpose in protecting Tenshi.
Arven
: A survivor of an expedition gone wrong, Arven witnessed firsthand of the dangers his Forefathers encountered when crossing the seas. Carrying a deep seated hatred for the creatures the people of Principium call: The Deep ones.
Casimir
: Growing up by himself, Casimir quickly adapted to living in the wilds of Principium, and is always hungry for more food and action. As well as an excellent hunter, Casimir is very stealthy.
Luna
: Strong in her faith, her family hangs on to one of the only 2 religions on the island: Selenology. She believes that the moon brings balance, and as long as the moon rises at the end of the day, there will always be hope for those around her.
Tenshi
: Waking up in critical condition on the shores of principium as a child, Tenshi's arrival sparked many curiosities amongst the people of the island. From how he was able to survive whilst missing half of his limbs, to where he hailed from. He was found to have a knack for inventing, creating several inventions ranged from his prosthetics to his Brother-Like Automaton A.L.
SECTION C: STORYLINE/PLOT
Spoiler
Long ago, mankind roamed the planet, seeking new lands and adventures, building connections with each other all over the world. Helping each other, lifting others up when they fell down. A true era of peace and prosperity reigned, but even peace, cannot last forever. A great calamity came from the sky, giving birth to monsters all around the planet. With no where else to turn, humanity forced to flee their homelands and retreat across the sea.
After a rough journey with many casualties, they eventually stumbled on the island of Principium. You play as one of the 5 Protagonists, whom each make up Squad 56 of the Principium Vanguard. Each character has a different point of view of the events that will happen in the game!
DOWNLOAD LINK
Spoiler
Currently in the process of posting the demo to steam, waiting on approval and hoping it'll be posted by January 1st of 2026.
I also want to say big thank you to everyone who's helped me on this forum, as i wouldn't have gotten this far without some of your guys' help!
Feel free to ask any questions if you have any! I'll answer them as soon as i can.
